value.rationale: The result locates a sharp compact/noncompact/unbounded boundary in a geometrically accumulating atomic Helson model and identifies the entire nonzero essential spectrum and essential norm in theta functions. The exact quantitative band is structurally different from earlier compact damped eigenvalue asymptotics and from continuous-measure Hilbert spectra, with direct relevance to sampling stability and essential Fredholm behavior.
